tips.text: Run public Deimos bounties during Fass and let squadmates' Infested hits weaken Panzers for you while you earn standing.
Bring an invisibility frame like Loki, Ivara or Ash so the Infested go for the animal instead of you.
Pull a pack of Infested to the call site while invisible, then use the lure so the Panzer spawns into them.
Tranq the Panzer first so it cannot flee while Infested hit it.
Sweep the map in Archwing listening for Vulpaphyla cries and scope each animal with the tranq rifle instead of tracking on foot.
Pick the Antigen for its polarity, since that is a free Forma slot; Mutagen resistances matter less.
Clear Son's rotating tag exchanges while you do conservation to collect Son Tokens for gilding.
Expect a first Panzer within a few hours, often by accident; Entrati standing is the part that takes days.
Skip the solo lure-and-track hunt in the wrong cycle; nobody regrets the bounty route.
